messages:
mira: Heads-up — q4_k (4-bit quantized candidate) bring-up on staging shows a ~6% absolute drop on the math_arith promptset vs fp16. Curious about whether this is a quantization regression or a dedupe/holdout leak.

chris: Can you paste a few failing examples and the metric diffs? ie exact prompts + fp16 vs q4_k outputs.

mira: Pasted a tiny diff sample:
```
id: 98432
prompt: 'If 3x+5=20 what is x?'
fp16: 'x = 5'  (correct)
q4_k: 'x = 6'  (off-by-one)
metric: exact_match fp16=1.0 q4_k=0.0
```
Aggregate: accuracy fp16=0.88 q4_k=0.82 on math_arith-staging (n=1200).

samir: Thanks. Two fast asks: 1) run the dedupe/fingerprint check on the promptset against the golden bank — quant noise can expose near-duplicates that confuse evals; 2) add a quick failure-detection fallback in the rollout policy (if response token-level perplexity diverges >X or if answer confidence low, route to fp16).

samir: Fingerprint command we use: 
```
python infra/tools/fingerprint.py --input datasets/math_arith/staging.jsonl --against datasets/gold/anchors_v3.jsonl --threshold 0.82 --out staging_fingerprint.tsv
```
Should be fast on the index.

lee: Labeling can take a 300-item re-eval batch. We can do two passes (crowd + senior QC) if you mark priority. ETA 48h for first pass if we start now. Batch size?

mira: Let's do 300 curated fails + 200 random heldout items for calibration. Plan: 1) run fingerprinter, 2) dedupe and remove near-duplicates (>0.82 sim), 3) sample 300 worst-regressed items (by delta) + 200 control, 4) send to labeling for high-precision relabel.

chris: Also propose an A/B canary: route 10% traffic to q4_k, 90% to fp16; collect per-prompt divergence and auto-fail if rollout_experiment.divergence_rate > 0.03 after 1h. If fail, auto-fallback and alert. Ops can implement.

mira: Agreed. I don't want a full rollback yet — we just need triage. Samir, can you crank a quant-kernel debug build that logs logits and kv-cache alignment for the failing ids? A short sample will help isolate whether attention math is off.

samir: Yep. I'll push a debug build to staging by EOD that emits per-token logits parity diffs. Example log line: `logit_diff_mean=0.14 id=98432 step=7`. Will also add a runtime assert to compare topk tokens between fp16 and q4_k for the first 32 tokens.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/quant-debug -> 2061726000 by @samir (CI run started).

lee: Once fingerprint results are in, I'll annotate duplicates so they don't pollute the golden. Note: we should update the golden metadata with a `dedupe_version` tag so future audits can reproduce.

mira: Good point — add `dedupe_version=v2026-03-21-q4triage` to the golden metadata when we export. Also will open an eval-run ticket with links to the staging artifacts.

chris: I'll prepare the eval diff dashboard and add a simple script to compute per-category regression: `tools/eval_diff.py --base fp16 --cand q4_k --out diffs.csv` and include breakdown by prompt-type (arithmetic, unit-conversion, reasoning).

mira: Timeline: 1) Run fingerprint (samir) — 2h, 2) Produce curated batch (mira/chris) — 3h, 3) Labeling first pass (lee) — 48h, 4) Canary + monitors (ops/chris) — start after label sanity. Everyone ok?

samir: OK. I'll post the fingerprint TSV when ready.

lee: OK starting capacity probe, will post ETA update if we can accelerate. :100: 

mira: Thanks all — holding rollout until we confirm dedupe + label sanity. Will follow up with ticket and links. :mag:
